# netactuate_nke_vpc_lb_addon (Resource)

Manages a NKE VPC LB Addon.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_nke_vpc_lb_addon" "example" {
  cluster_id = netactuate_nke_cluster.example.cluster_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The NKE cluster ID

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `channel` (String) Addon channel
- `display_name` (String) Addon display name
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `installed_on` (String) Addon installation timestamp
- `state` (String) Addon state
- `update_available` (Boolean) Whether an addon update is available
- `version` (String) Addon version

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the cluster ID and the add-on type, netactuate-cloud-lb.
terraform import netactuate_nke_vpc_lb_addon.example 12345/netactuate-cloud-lb
```
